 JEE Main 2027 Information Brochure Released at jeemain.nta.nic.in: Check Session 1 & 2 Exam Dates, Registration Schedule
 Published
 4 hours ago on
 October 25, 2026 
 By
 Akshay Devar 
 The JEE Main 2027 Information Brochure has been released by the National Testing Agency (NTA). The board published the brochure on October 24, 2026 , on the official website, jeemain.nta.nic.in .
 The brochure includes the JEE Main 2027 exam dates , registration rules, syllabus, fees, exam pattern and eligibility details.
 As per the schedule, JEE Main 2027 Session 1 will take place on January 20, 21, 22, 23, 24 and 28, 2027 .
 Meanwhile, JEE Main 2027 Session 2 will be held from April 2 to 7, 2027 .
 Also, NTA has announced separate registration and correction dates for both sessions. Therefore, students should read the brochure before applying.

 JEE Main 2027 Brochure PDF Download Link
 Students can download the JEE Main 2027 Information Brochure PDF from the NTA website.
 First, open the official portal. Next, find the information bulletin or brochure link for JEE Main 2027.
 Official brochure download portal: JEE Main 2027 Information Brochure 
 NTA official website: nta.ac.in 
 The exact PDF file URL was not included in the reference. Therefore, the link above opens the official JEE Main website.
 How to Download JEE Main 2027 Information Brochure?
 The JEE Main 2027 brochure is available online. Students can download and save the file for future use.
 Before applying, candidates should read the full document. Also, this can help them avoid errors in the registration form.
 Follow these steps:
 Visit jeemain.nta.nic.in .
 Open the latest notices section.
 Find the JEE Main 2027 Information Brochure link.
 Click the brochure PDF.
 Check the exam dates and eligibility rules.
 Download the PDF.
 Finally, save or print it.
 Also, students should check the website for any later notices.
 JEE Main 2027 Registration Dates and Application Process
 The JEE Main 2027 Session 1 registration started on October 24, 2026.
 Students can submit the form until November 22, 2026, at 11:50 PM . Meanwhile, Session 2 registration will begin on January 5, 2027.
 To apply, students must create an account, enter their details and upload the required documents.
 Next, they must pay the application fee and submit the form.
 Also, NTA has provided a late fee window for each session. However, the exact late fee amount is not given in the reference.
 Therefore, students should check the brochure for category-wise fees.
 JEE Main 2027 Eligibility Criteria
 The JEE Main 2027 eligibility criteria are explained in the official brochure. Also, students should check the rules for Class 12 passing year, subjects and other admission needs.
 Also, candidates must review the rules for their chosen course before applying.
 The brochure includes:
 Age-related eligibility rules
 Class 12 passing year rules
 Required subjects
 Category and reservation rules
 PwD/PwBD guidelines
 Admission-related conditions
 However, the supplied reference does not give the exact eligibility limits.
 Therefore, students should follow the official NTA brochure rather than assume they are eligible.
 What Details Are Mentioned in JEE Main 2027 Brochure?
 The JEE Main 2027 Information Bulletin contains key details about the entrance exam.
 First, it explains the application steps. Next, it gives the exam pattern and marking rules.
 The brochure also covers the JEE Main 2027 syllabus , exam cities, reservation rules and NTA Score calculation.
 Moreover, students can find exam day rules and instructions for candidates with disabilities.
 Therefore, reading the complete brochure can help students plan their exam preparation.
 JEE Main 2027 Admit Card and City Intimation Slip Dates
 NTA has announced the dates for the JEE Main 2027 city intimation slips and admit cards.
 The city slip tells students their allotted exam city. However, it is not the admit card.

 JEE Main 2027 Information Brochure: FAQs
 1. Is the JEE Main 2027 information brochure released? 
 Yes. NTA released the JEE Main 2027 brochure on October 24, 2026 .
 2. When will JEE Main 2027 Session 1 exams be held? 
 Session 1 exams will take place on January 20, 21, 22, 23, 24 and 28, 2027 .
 3. What are the JEE Main 2027 Session 2 exam dates? 
 Session 2 exams are scheduled for April 2–7, 2027 .
 4. What is the JEE Main 2027 Session 1 registration last date? 
 The deadline is November 22, 2026, at 11:50 PM .
 5. When will JEE Main 2027 Session 1 admit cards be released? 
 The admit card release date is January 13, 2027 .
 6. Where can I download the JEE Main 2027 brochure PDF? 
 Visit jeemain.nta.nic.in and open the information brochure link.
